high_level_description: A pile of emptied pearly food shells and two dark metal supply cases, one open with plum light, beside a sleeping giant's bed, on the bare tan stone floor of a camp on a high plateau.

style_description.aesthetics: the gear of a star faring people's camp, made of rose gold, pearly opalescent shell, plum starlight and dark metal with orange glyph seams, one coherent pixel art scene
style_description.lighting: cold morning sun from the upper left with cool blue shadows
style_description.art_style: crisp clustered pixel art at one pixel size, flat colour planes with hard pixel edges, a few hue shifted shades per material, the same pixel art as the floor around it

compositional_deconstruction.background: the flat tan stone floor of a bare high plateau in bright cold morning light

elements.desc: a pile of emptied pearly opalescent food shells
two dark metal supply cases with orange glyph seams, one open with plum light inside
